questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to train a dog
How British attitudes to pets have changed
Why cats are more popular than dogs
Pets that have become famous on social media
questions.why: Neil says they'll hear how our relationship with pets has changed over the centuries.

questions.q: Why does Neil say he is a “dog person”?
options: Dogs are cheaper and easier to keep than cats
He grew up with dogs
He is allergic to cats
He wants a friendly pet that loves him
questions.why: He wants a pet that's friendly and loves him, not a lazy cat waiting for food.

questions.q: What happened in the UK for the first time in 2021?
options: More homes had a pet than didn't
Cats became more popular than dogs
Half of all pets joined social media
Owners stopped keeping pets indoors
questions.why: 18 million homes had a pet, so for the first time there were more households with one than without.

options: Pets were banned from homes in most of the big cities in Britain
People stopped keeping dogs
People began using the word “pet” and keeping pets indoors
Pets were first used for hunting
questions.why: Neil says people started using the word “pet” and gradually it became normal to keep pets indoors.

questions.q: What practical reason does Professor Jane Hamlett give for more people keeping pets?
options: Living standards rose, so people had more money to spare
Pets became cheaper to buy
The government gave people pets
People needed animals like big dogs to protect their homes
questions.why: She says living standards increased, and it became possible with more disposable income.

questions.q: What cultural reason does Professor Hamlett give?
options: People wanted to show off their pets to their neighbours
Families became more important, and pets joined them
Churches encouraged people to keep animals
Children demanded pets
questions.why: She says home and family were celebrated, and animals became part of the family.

questions.q: Why does Georgie mention Charles Dickens?
options: He wrote the very first book about keeping pets at home
He hated dogs
He is an example of a Victorian with an unusual pet
He started the phrase “nation of dog lovers”
questions.why: After mentioning exotic Victorian pets, she says even Dickens owned a pet raven.

questions.q: According to Professor Hamlett, why were dogs the top pet for the Victorians?
options: Dogs were easier to feed than cats
Dogs were brought back to Britain from all over the empire
Queen Victoria owned many dogs
Dogs had qualities, like loyalty, that Victorians admired
questions.why: She says loyalty, trustfulness and steadfastness were key parts of the Victorian manly character.
